We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.es/Overview/Working-at-DocPlanner-EI_IE1071394.11,21.htm?countryRedirect=true speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us https://bit.ly/3xwnSAk.




AND WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.





THE OPPORTUNITY

A doctor told us: "I used to see 13 patients a day and felt exhausted. Now I see 20 without feeling tired." Another: "I forget the tool is even on. I just focus on my patient."

That's what we're building toward. Not better software — a clinic that runs itself, so the people inside it can focus entirely on care.

Docplanner already supports 300,000 doctors across 13 markets and facilitates more than 20 million appointments every month. As we evolve into an AI-powered operating system for healthcare, our opportunity is much bigger: our current markets alone represent a potential reach of five million doctors.

We’re looking for the design leader who will shape that future—creating the products and experiences that help doctors run their practices and deliver better care.




THE ROLE

You'll lead design across the full experience of doctors and clinics on Docplanner: the practice management tools they use to run their day, the AI layer that assists them during consultations and beyond, and the way they discover and grow on our platform.

You'll hire and shape your own team from the ground up. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and product leadership as a true peer — not a service to them. You'll spend real time with the people who use what you build, extracting what they can't quite articulate, and turning it into something so simple it disappears into the work.

The people using what you build chose medicine, not software. They should never feel the difference.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You start from the problem, not the pixels. You can tell the difference between a screen that looks finished and an experience that actually works — and you care far more about the second. You've shipped things that were beautiful and still failed, and you don't want to repeat that.

 - You lead through the work, not from a distance. You don’t need to be the person designing every screen, but you can raise the quality of a solution through sharp critique, clear product judgment, strong examples, and a deep understanding of what good design looks like in practice.

 - You prove it with users. Your own taste isn't enough for you. You put work in front of the people who'll use it, watch where they get stuck, and you've changed or killed your own ideas because the evidence said so. "I think it's good" isn't the bar — "it solved the problem" is.

 - You think in behavior, not just interfaces. You understand why people do what they do — the habits, the anxieties, the shortcuts they take when no one's watching. You design around real human psychology, not idealized flows. This matters now; it matters even more as AI reshapes what an interface even is — from screens people click through to systems that adapt, anticipate, and respond. You're energized by that shift and already thinking about what design means when the product starts meeting the user halfway.

 - You've led design for a real product. Not a portfolio of concepts — something people depend on day to day, ideally complex and multi-user, where a wrong call has real consequences. You've owned a significant product area end to end.

 - You've grown designers and raised the bar for the function. You've managed, coached, or developed strong designers, set a high standard through the work itself, and left teams better than you found them.

 - You can show impact, not just artifacts. You can point to a problem you took on and what changed because of it — steps removed, confusion gone, time handed back, a number that moved.

 - AI is part of how you work — how you think, prototype, and lead. Not a tool you're still making your mind up about.

You don't need to come from healthcare, and you don't need to tick every line above. If most of this sounds like you and you've got work to show for it, we want to see it.




WHY NOW

We’re rethinking design in this area from scratch. No inherited decisions to defend, no incumbent way of doing things to protect. The scope will grow with you.

Our ambition: 1 billion patient visits supported every year within the next decade. Every unnecessary step removed, every moment of confusion eliminated — it compounds.



Show us your portfolio. We care about how you think.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE




Six to twelve months in, here's what "good" looks like:



 - The goals move. The doctors and clinics using what your team builds get through their day with less friction — fewer steps, fewer support tickets, more time with patients. You can name the outcomes you're driving and show real progress against them.

 - The experience is something people stop noticing — not because it's plain, but because it just works. You've spent real time with doctors, you know exactly where it breaks today, and those broken parts are getting fixed and validated with the people who live in the product, not signed off in a review.

 - You know what's working and can prove it. You don't wait for someone else to tell you whether a release landed. You've built a habit — in yourself and your team — of closing the loop: what did we ship, what changed, what didn't. You're comfortable with product metrics, you pull your own data or pair with analysts who do, and you use what you learn to decide what to do next, not just to report what happened.

 - You've built a team that ships value and wants to stay. The designers you hire are doing the best work of their careers, they own their problems end to end, and they're shipping things that matter instead of polishing things that don't. The bar is high and the team is energized by it, not worn down.




BENEFITS:

 - Share Options plan

 - Flexible remuneration and benefits system via Flexoh https://flexoh.com/, which includes: restaurant card, transportation card, kindergarten, and training tax savings.


TRUE FLEXIBILITY AND WORK-LIFE BALANCE

 - Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in Barcelona.

 - Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly).

 - Summer intensive schedule during July and August (work 7 hours, finish earlier).

 - 23 paid holidays, with exchangeable local bank holidays.

 - Additional paid holiday on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).


HEALTH COMES FIRST

 - Private healthcare plan with Adeslas https://www.segurcaixaadeslas.es/en/particulares for you and subsidized for your family (medical and dental).

 - Access to hundreds of gyms for a symbolic fee in partnership for you and your family with Andjoy https://www.andjoy.life/en.

 - Access to iFeel https://ifeelonline.com/, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling.


KEEP GROWING WITH US

 - Free English and Spanish classes.



We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

“We believe all humans, in all their beautiful diversity, should have equal rights, dignity and respect. Period.” Mariusz Gralewski, CEO

jobs.title: Global Strategy Analyst - Customer Success (Remote Friendly)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

As our organization continues to scale and evolve, we need strong operational excellence to ensure our teams deliver maximum value efficiently. We’re looking for a smart, independent operator who can combine strategy, analytics, and Technical Project Management execution to help build the next generation of global, AI-first Customer Success.

What makes this role exciting?

Our company has grown from a small local startup into a global SaaS organization, and this role is central to the next phase of that journey. You will help replace fragmented local practices with scalable global ways of working, while still adapting to local market realities.

This is a role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, bringing structure to complexity, and making things happen across multiple stakeholders. You will have real ownership, high visibility, and the opportunity to help build an AI-enabled Customer Success function from the ground up.

In this role, you are contributing by…

  • Supporting the design and creation of the global Customer Success function of the future, relating to:

    • Insights (customer journey customisation, research projects, experimentation)

    • Productivity (product automations, operations effort optimisation and capacity utilisation)

    • Best practices (cross-market sharing, external expertise/benchmarks)

  • Help define, test, and roll out AI-first Customer Success use cases.

    • Prioritize use cases according to impact.

    • Ensure they are practical, measurable, and adopted by teams.

    • Forward thinking in terms of scalability and customer journey.

  • Independently leading data analytics and modelling with a special focus on Retention and Growth.

    • Data queries and solid understanding of data management topics (Superset, Tableau, SQL)

    • Machine learning application (prediction models, clustering, decision trees etc.)

    • Business/financial modelling (business analysis, forecasting, budget simulations)

  • Supporting the execution of key strategic projects / initiatives in the markets, working hand in hand with local teams in our DP countries.

    • Scale results/experiments from one market into global projects

    • Liaise with in-market stakeholders to align on project direction and status

    • Act as a TPM for selected initiatives, coordinating stakeholders, timelines, risks, and follow-up.

Qualifications

What will help you thrive?

  • You have 3–5 years of experience in strategy, operations, analytics, project management, or a related role.

  • Ideally, a Data Science, Statistics, Math/Physics, CS, Finance or similarly quantitatively oriented educational background

  • Technical expertise in working with large data sets:

    • Knowledge of Superset/Tableau/ reporting tools - ability to edit/create dashboards

    • Knowledge of SQL, DBT and experience in working with databases - e.g. from prior BI experience

    • Desirable but not mandatory - knowledge and passion for data science (Python modelling experience; knowledge of the key data science algorithms: clustering, regression, decision trees, x-gradient boost, etc.)

  • Desirable proven experience in designing and implementing advanced analytics (data preparation, feature engineering, sample management, model validation and productization)

  • Prior experience in business analysis and modelling will be a plus (financial models, forecasting, business performance measurement etc.)

  • Interest in and practical ability to apply AI in Customer Success operations.

  • Proven experience working with multicultural teams, demonstrated communication skills and ability to navigate within a complex organisation

  • Demonstrated experience in collaborating with both data engineering and product/operational teams - experience on operating and improving “live” processes

  • Able to package insights and communicate with stakeholders/ lead working sessions with teams.

  • You're fluent in English (any other languages specially Spanish, Portuguese & Polish - are a plus!)

This role is remote first and can be ideally based in Spain. On a second note, Poland, Mexico or Brazil.

What to Expect from Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner Giuliana to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

3️⃣Additional Interview – A conversation with a senior leader from the Global Customer Success team to get a sense of how you might collaborate together and to explore team fit.

4️⃣ Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with one of your main stakeholders from our Global Team.

6️⃣References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

  • Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.

  • Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.

  • Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

jobs.title: Salesforce Developer - Service Cloud, Experience Cloud & AI (100% Remote within Poland)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Welcome to the good side of tech 👋

You might have heard about us, but with a different name: ZnanyLekarz. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

At Docplanner we are a diverse group of over 300 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.

 

Role summary

We’re scaling an APEX-first Salesforce platform across multiple countries and business lines. As a Salesforce Developer, you’ll design and build scalable Salesforce solutions that power our Customer Support/Success mainly and Customer Experience ecosystem. You'll develop robust backend services, integrations, Experience Cloud capabilities, Digital Engagement channels, and AI-driven customer interactions while collaborating with Product, Business Analysts, Architects, Admins, and QA to deliver reliable, high-quality releases.

 

What you’ll do

  • Design and implement scalable APEX solutions (domain/service/selector patterns, one-trigger-per-object, bulkified and governor-safe).

  • Develop and enhance Service Cloud capabilities including complex case management, entitlements, milestones, routing, and customer service automation.

  • Build and customize Experience Cloud sites to support customer and partner self-service experiences.

  • Implement and extend Digital Engagement capabilities including Chat, Messaging, WhatsApp, SMS, Facebook Messenger, and other supported customer communication channels.

  • Build and enhance Bots and AI-powered customer service automations, integrating them with Apex, Flows, and external systems.

  • Design and develop secure Apex REST APIs, callouts (Named Credentials), Platform Events, async Apex (Queueable, Batch, Schedulable, Future), and CDC-driven solutions.

  • Develop Apex services consumed by Lightning Web Components, Experience Cloud, Flows, and AI Agents.

  • Optimize SOQL/SOSL queries and ensure high performance for large-volume Service Cloud data operations.

  • Create invocable Apex to extend Flows and bot conversations where declarative capabilities are insufficient.

  • Proactively participate in solution design, applying Salesforce best practices and scalable architecture principles.

  • Collaborate in design reviews with Architects and align on security, scalability, performance, and maintainability requirements.

  • Partner with DevOps on CI/CD using Git, Pull Requests, SFDX/DevOps Center, packaging, and safe deployment strategies.

  • Support UAT and troubleshoot incidents using logs, debug tools, and event monitoring.

  • Document technical decisions and APIs while maintaining Jira tickets

  • Customize Salesforce objects, fields, page layouts, record types, search layouts, list views, queues, reports, and dashboards.

  • Configure and maintain automations including Flows, approval processes, assignment rules, escalation rules, Omni-Channel routing, and email automations.

  • Maintain Salesforce security including users, roles, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, field-level security, validation rules, and Experience Cloud access.

  • Optimize existing implementations to reduce technical debt and improve platform health, scalability, and efficiency.

  • Promote Salesforce development best practices.

  • Contribute to the overall Salesforce architecture strategy, ensuring long-term scalability, maintainability, and performance.

What success looks like

  • Features meet acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements while passing UAT on the first attempt.

  • Deliver scalable customer service solutions across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Digital Engagement, and AI channels.

  • Improve customer self-service adoption through Experience Cloud and AI-powered support.

  • Build reliable conversational experiences that reduce agent workload while maintaining excellent customer experience.

  • Zero governor-limit regressions and excellent runtime performance on high-volume data.

  • Healthy pull request metrics with small, well-reviewed changes and consistently green CI pipelines.

  • Reduced defect rates and improved delivery cycle times across projects.

Required experience

  • 2–5+ years of Salesforce development experience with a strong focus on Apex.

  • Strong hands-on experience implementing and customizing Salesforce Service Cloud.

  • Experience developing solutions for Experience Cloud (Customer and/or Partner portals).

  • Experience implementing or extending Digital Engagement capabilities including Chat, Messaging, WhatsApp, SMS, or similar customer communication channels.

  • Experience developing or integrating Einstein Bots, Agentforce, AI Assistants, or conversational AI solutions.

  • Proven experience with enterprise Apex patterns (trigger frameworks, domain/service/selector patterns), bulkification, and asynchronous processing.

  • Strong integration experience using Apex REST, HTTP callouts, Platform Events, Named Credentials, and asynchronous integrations.

  • Strong SOQL performance tuning skills and solid understanding of Salesforce data modeling.

  • Good understanding of Salesforce security including sharing models, CRUD/FLS enforcement, Experience Cloud security, and guest user access.

  • Experience configuring and supporting Omni-Channel routing, queues, skills-based routing, and customer service workflows.

  • Solid understanding of the Service Cloud data model including Cases, Accounts, Contacts, Knowledge, Entitlements, Milestones, and related objects.

  • Experience developing Lightning Web Components (LWC).

  • Comfortable with Git workflows, code reviews, and CI/CD using SFDX or DevOps Center.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Admins, QA, and Architects.

  • Professional working proficiency in English.

  • Salesforce certifications such as:

    • Platform Developer I or II

    • Service Cloud Consultant

    • Experience Cloud Consultant

 

Nice to have

  • Experience implementing and customizing Salesforce Knowledge.

  • Experience with Data Cloud and customer service use cases.

  • Experience with Prompt Builder, Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, AI Agents, or other generative AI capabilities within Salesforce.

  • Salesforce certifications such as:

    • AI Associate

    • Agentforce Specialist

    • Administrator or Advanced Administrator

How we work

  • Weekly design reviews with Architects and lightweight automated quality gates in CI.

  • Focus time is respected, with asynchronous communication through Jira and Confluence.

  • Small, iterative releases with continuous improvement and shared ownership of platform quality.

 

Apply: Send your CV/LinkedIn and (optionally) a short code sample or architectural note (e.g., trigger framework snippet, Platform Events design) you’re proud of.

 

Benefits:

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills.

True flexibility and work-life balance

  • Remote or hybrid work model with or hub in Warsaw;

  • Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly);

  • 20/26 days of paid time off (depending on your contract);

  • Additional paid day off on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).

Health comes first

  • Private healthcare plan with Signal Iduna for you and subsidized for your family.

ROLE SUMMARY

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and implement scalable APEX solutions (domain/service/selector patterns, one-trigger-per-object, bulkified and governor-safe).

 - Build and customize Experience Cloud sites to support customer and partner self-service experiences.

 - Implement and extend Digital Engagement capabilities including Chat, Messaging, WhatsApp, SMS, Facebook Messenger, and other supported customer communication channels.

 - Build and enhance Bots and AI-powered customer service automations, integrating them with Apex, Flows, and external systems.

 - Develop Apex services consumed by Lightning Web Components, Experience Cloud, Flows, and AI Agents.

 - Optimize SOQL/SOSL queries and ensure high performance for large-volume Service Cloud data operations.

 - Create invocable Apex to extend Flows and bot conversations where declarative capabilities are insufficient.

 - Proactively participate in solution design, applying Salesforce best practices and scalable architecture principles.

 - Document technical decisions and APIs while maintaining Jira tickets

 - Customize Salesforce objects, fields, page layouts, record types, search layouts, list views, queues, reports, and dashboards.

 - Configure and maintain automations including Flows, approval processes, assignment rules, escalation rules, Omni-Channel routing, and email automations.

 - Maintain Salesforce security including users, roles, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, field-level security, validation rules, and Experience Cloud access.

 - Optimize existing implementations to reduce technical debt and improve platform health, scalability, and efficiency.

 - Promote Salesforce development best practices.

 - Contribute to the overall Salesforce architecture strategy, ensuring long-term scalability, maintainability, and performance.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Features meet acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements while passing UAT on the first attempt.

 - Deliver scalable customer service solutions across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Digital Engagement, and AI channels.

 - Improve customer self-service adoption through Experience Cloud and AI-powered support.

 - Build reliable conversational experiences that reduce agent workload while maintaining excellent customer experience.

 - Zero governor-limit regressions and excellent runtime performance on high-volume data.

 - Healthy pull request metrics with small, well-reviewed changes and consistently green CI pipelines.

 - Reduced defect rates and improved delivery cycle times across projects.


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

 - 2–5+ years of Salesforce development experience with a strong focus on Apex.

 - Strong hands-on experience implementing and customizing Salesforce Service Cloud.

 - Experience developing solutions for Experience Cloud (Customer and/or Partner portals).

 - Experience implementing or extending Digital Engagement capabilities including Chat, Messaging, WhatsApp, SMS, or similar customer communication channels.

 - Experience developing or integrating Einstein Bots, Agentforce, AI Assistants, or conversational AI solutions.

 - Proven experience with enterprise Apex patterns (trigger frameworks, domain/service/selector patterns), bulkification, and asynchronous processing.

 - Strong integration experience using Apex REST, HTTP callouts, Platform Events, Named Credentials, and asynchronous integrations.

 - Strong SOQL performance tuning skills and solid understanding of Salesforce data modeling.

 - Good understanding of Salesforce security including sharing models, CRUD/FLS enforcement, Experience Cloud security, and guest user access.

 - Experience configuring and supporting Omni-Channel routing, queues, skills-based routing, and customer service workflows.

 - Solid understanding of the Service Cloud data model including Cases, Accounts, Contacts, Knowledge, Entitlements, Milestones, and related objects.

 - Experience developing Lightning Web Components (LWC).

 - Comfortable with Git workflows, code reviews, and CI/CD using SFDX or DevOps Center.

 - Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Admins, QA, and Architects.

 - Professional working proficiency in English.

 - Salesforce certifications such as:
   
   - Platform Developer I or II
   
   - Service Cloud Consultant
   
   - Experience Cloud Consultant

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience implementing and customizing Salesforce Knowledge.

 - Experience with Data Cloud and customer service use cases.

 - Experience with Prompt Builder, Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, AI Agents, or other generative AI capabilities within Salesforce.

 - Salesforce certifications such as:
   
   - AI Associate
   
   - Agentforce Specialist
   
   - Administrator or Advanced Administrator


HOW WE WORK

 - Weekly design reviews with Architects and lightweight automated quality gates in CI.

 - Focus time is respected, with asynchronous communication through Jira and Confluence.

 - Small, iterative releases with continuous improvement and shared ownership of platform quality.

 

Apply: Send your CV/LinkedIn and (optionally) a short code sample or architectural note (e.g., trigger framework snippet, Platform Events design) you’re proud of.

True flexibility and work-life balance

jobs.title: Pricing Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

This role is remote within Brazil

Your main project is the listing-based pricing rollout across markets. You'll diagnose what's working, propose fixes, get local and global teams on board, and roll out to new countries with clear targets and a steady weekly cadence. You'll also shape how the model evolves for next year.

You'll own the ARPU (average revenue per user) target for the segment. Alongside the main project, you'll:

  • Move the ARPU target through specific pricing moves: tighter discount discipline, package mix shifts, price resets by market. Dig into anomalies fast.

  • Spot pricing opportunities across the marketplace that no one's looking at, and make the case for them.

  • Own the segment's pricing recommendations to GTM leadership: propose the moves, defend the trade-offs with data, turn decisions into rollout plans.

  • Drive alignment across sales, local commercial, and global teams on contested pricing calls, without formal authority.

  • Generate optimization hypotheses grounded in data.

  • Design and run behavioral experiments to validate pricing moves before scaling them.

  • Adjust and follow up on budget assumptions as we learn from the market.

  • Maintain country price lists in our internal systems.

Qualifications

What will help you thrive?

  • 5+ years in pricing, ideally SaaS or marketplace

  • Direct experience working with GTM or sales leaders on pricing decisions

  • Thorough with data. You back conclusions with numbers.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you know when to stop analyzing and start testing

  • Ability to explain complex numbers simply

  • SQL good enough to pull your own data

  • Strong Google Sheets skills

  • Professional English, comfortable in meetings and writing (B2 or above)

  • Degree in economics, math, business, or similar

What to Expect from Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣ TestGorilla – (SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣ Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems.

4️⃣ Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with Douglas Giehl (Global Pricing Director) and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

5️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

  • Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.

  • Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.

  • Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

jobs.title: People Experience (HR) Director, Go-to-Market (remote in Europe)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
People Experience Director — GTM Business Partner

Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients. Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

The role

You own how People Experience actually runs in our core markets: Poland, Germany, Spain, Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Italy, Türkiye, and our Enterprise business unit, TuoTempo. That's 2,200+ DPralians and the local PX Heads who serve them.

Reporting to our Deputy Chief People Officer, Adanya, you will lead the People Experience (PX) Heads (several of which are leaders, making this a leader of leaders role), partner with our COO, Carlos, and Country Managers, and sit on the PX Leadership team. Your job is to keep international teams focused on what matters most and to make sure it lands — on time, to standard, every quarter. You'll also deep-dive local situations directly on behalf of the dCPO or COO when they need it.

The bar is disciplined, relentless execution.

You will create value by

  • Running the PX operating model in every market. High-quality execution of the core BAU, measured against KPI targets — plus hands-on support to markets that need help hitting them.

  • Owning the business reviews. Country reviews with Country Heads and local PX Heads, and the full Go-to-Market PX review with the dCPO and COO. Clear visibility, honest gap-spotting, and a plan to close each gap.

  • Raising talent density in country leadership teams. Assess bench strength internationally and, with the COO, drive the changes needed through mobility, development or replacement. You take an active role in selecting country leadership team members, advise Country Managers and the COO, and facilitate talent moves — global to local and between locations — where they're the best outcome for Docplanner as a whole.

  • Being the voice of the markets inside global PX. Bring local reality into global projects so solutions are designed for the countries that will run them, and make sure global teams prioritize local demands by criticality.

  • Making local PX teams more efficient. Track productivity against defined standards and convert process, technology and other improvements into real gains.

  • Coaching the local PX leaders. Continuous feedback, support on the hard local calls, and a stronger international PX leadership bench as the result.

What you'll bring

  • An HR Business Partner at heart, from GTM. You've led large markets first-hand, you can hold HR strategy and ground-level HR operations in the same pair of hands, and you don't get distracted by shiny objects or unproven trends.

  • Scale and complexity. Regional or global HR leadership for at least 1,500 people, with HR teams of 50+ including dotted lines.

  • Restlessness in execution and follow-up. You miss no deadlines and you chase until things are closed. You don't bend on commitments — time, quality or actual delivery — and you hold people accountable.

  • Relationships that survive hard conversations. You build trust with business leaders, steer them in the right direction, and occasionally talk sense into them. You lead through influence and expertise, not authority.

  • Cultural range. You navigate a global-and-local organization, converge different ways of working through empathy and common ground, and champion diversity and inclusion in a way that's genuinely relevant locally while staying true to what Docplanner stands for.

  • A data instinct, not a data reflex. You connect business goals to the numbers that actually measure them — and you know when a number isn't the answer.

How success is measured

  • Progress against Go-to-Market PX OITs and KPIs, particularly those tied to the operating model

  • Sales and Customer Success turnover, plus engagement and attrition of high performers

  • New hire retention, and hiring against budget

  • eNPS

  • Speed of underperformance resolution, within the defined timeframe

  • Qualitatively: feedback from business and PX leaders, and the completion, timeliness and accuracy of the global processes driven by other functions and PX teams.

Our process of getting to know each other

  1. Talent Acquisition interview - with Flore

  2. Manager interview - with Adanya

  3. Stakeholder interviews - with Luco and Carlos (in parallel)

  4. Business case - with Adanya, Luco and Carlos

  5. (potential final interview to clarify remaining questions)

Logistics

This role is remote-first, based in one of our European markets (ideally Spain).

Please note we are publishing this opening in multiple locations, but that applying to one opening is enough! :)

jobs.title: Product Analyst, Payments (100% Remote within Poland)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Welcome to the good side of tech 👋

You might have heard about us, but with a different name: Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

At Docplanner we are a diverse group of over 300 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.

In this role as a Product Analyst at Docplanner you'll own the metrics and analytical direction for your product area, working directly with Product Directors to influence strategy and roadmap priorities. Your insights will drive real decisions: what we build, what we kill, and where we invest next.

This means the autonomy to dig into the problems that matter, challenge conventional thinking, and push for change when the data tells a different story. You'll define what success looks like, build the frameworks to measure it, and make sure every major decision is backed by solid analysis.

You'll work with a talented team of analysts, researchers, product managers, designers, and engineers who are obsessed with building the best product. Your analyses will directly shape Product strategy and influence how millions of patients and healthcare professionals experience Docplanner.

About the Payments team

DP Payments is a sub-unit of two fully autonomous product teams, PMs, engineers and a designer — with the mandate and capability to work across virtually any app or repository in the Docplanner ecosystem. We're building a new revenue stream for the company, which means combining the maturity of a scale-up with the agility of a startup.

The challenge

Payments has to live inside almost every app and view Docplanner has. We don't get the comfort of a greenfield or a clean separation, but we're held to the expectations of one. The challenge is to keep iterating fast inside a complex ecosystem of mature processes and products.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Help product areas to strategically build the product: bring ideas for new growth opportunities based on your expertise, estimate the potential impact of such ideas and guide our strategy through metric frameworks and insights.

  • Work with higher management, business stakeholders and researchers to create and validate hypotheses from both a qualitative and quantitative perspective.

  • Create and maintain dashboards, analysis and forecasts related to our team’s main metrics.

  • Manipulate and transform large data-sets to bring new insights and perform root-cause analysis.

  • Collaborate with the Product team to test new features and validate hypotheses through experimentation and AB Testing.

  • Perform segmentation analysis to understand who our customers are and what are their main drivers to engage with our products.

  • Build, maintain and continuously evolve the analytics stack for a complex set of processes spread across many apps and technologies — centred on accepting and processing patient payments to doctors and clinics for their appointments.

Who are you?

  • You are curious by nature, and you love to ask and answer questions and dig into data.

  • You like finding patterns in data and proactively suggesting stakeholders how to improve the product.

  • You have an excellent understanding of statistics.

  • You enjoy constant learning and high autonomy.

  • You enjoy being part of a diverse analytics team.

  • You enjoy training and coaching others.

  • You are familiar with complex Product organizations in the SaaS market.

  • You enjoy using cutting-edge tools, frameworks and incorporating AI to automate and improve your work.

What skills and experiences do we want you to have?

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in analytics, working with business KPIs and metrics, of which 2+ working closely with product managers and user research teams.

  • You are familiar with the tools that we use:

    • Proficiency in SQL (essential) and experienced with DBT.

    • Data visualization tools such as Tableau, PowerBI or similar (essential)

    • Event-tracking tools such as Google Analytics, Amplitude or similar (essential)

    • Python and its ecosystem of Data Science libraries

    • Experienced in working with Claude Code or similar AI IDEs.

  • Great communication skills and stakeholder management. You translate complex analyses into clear insights that executives and stakeholders actually act on.

  • Fluent in manipulating, transforming, and reshaping data, preferably from multiple data sources.

  • Doing root-cause analysis, applying statistical concepts like regressions, and proving correlations and causation.

  • Contributing to data warehouses, creating aggregated data sets, general understanding of data pipelines and flows.

  • Experience designing, implementing and measuring A/B Tests and interpreting the results.

  • Experience enabling others by training stakeholders on tools and helping teams become more data-literate and autonomous.

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills: : ranging from 19,000 PLN to 24,000 PLN per month.

  • B2B or CoE contracts, it's up to you.

True flexibility and work-life balance

  • Remote or hybrid work model with or hub in Warsaw;

  • Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly);

  • 20/26 days of paid time off (depending on your contract);

  • Additional paid day off on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).

Health comes first

  • Private healthcare plan with Signal Iduna for you and subsidized for your family.

  • Multisport card co-financing for you to have access to sports facilities across Poland.

  • Access to iFeel, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling.

Keep growing with us

  • Free English and Spanish classes.

We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

“We believe all humans, in all their beautiful diversity, should have equal rights, dignity and respect. Period.” Mariusz Gralewski, CEO

 - Work with higher management, business stakeholders and researchers to create and validate hypotheses from both a qualitative and quantitative perspective.

 - Create and maintain dashboards, analysis and forecasts related to our team’s main metrics.

 - Manipulate and transform large data-sets to bring new insights and perform root-cause analysis.

 - Collaborate with the Product team to test new features and validate hypotheses through experimentation and AB Testing.

 - Perform segmentation analysis to understand who our customers are and what are their main drivers to engage with our products.

 - You enjoy being part of a diverse analytics team.

 - You enjoy training and coaching others.

 - You are familiar with complex Product organizations in the SaaS market.

   - Data visualization tools such as Tableau, PowerBI or similar (essential)
   
   - Event-tracking tools such as Google Analytics, Amplitude or similar (essential)
   
   - Python and its ecosystem of Data Science libraries
   
   - Experienced in working with Claude Code or similar AI IDEs.

 - Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly);

 - 20/26 days of paid time off (depending on your contract);

 - Additional paid day off on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).

 - Private healthcare plan with Signal Iduna  https://www.signaliduna.pl/for you and subsidized for your family.

jobs.title: Freelance - Spanish Data Annotation Specialist (100% Remote within Europe)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
How You'll Contribute

As a Freelance Spanish Data Annotation Specialist at Docplanner, your main focus will be preparing and curating linguistically and medically oriented datasets in Spanish to power our machine learning and natural language processing (NLP) initiatives. You will work independently while maintaining clear communication with our NLP experts, ensuring the accuracy and relevance of our data for the Spanish market, and contributing directly to the quality and reliability of our AI-driven products in the medical domain.

This role is ideal for candidates with a strong linguistic background in Spanish who are passionate about working in the healthcare and technology space. The ideal candidate has experience in data annotation, transcription, and text analysis, combined with a basic understanding of medical terminology and concepts.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and maintain medically oriented datasets for machine learning purposes, ensuring high-quality data annotation and consistency.

  • Follow and provide feedback on annotation and labeling conventions, as well as perform audio transcriptions in Spanish (aligning audio with text and correcting text based on audio).

  • Implement text patterns to detect and extract named entities in Spanish, such as names, addresses, organization names, ID numbers, and medical terms.

  • Contribute to dictionaries and taxonomies in Spanish for use in NLP systems.

  • Evaluate the correctness and accuracy of Spanish words, sentences, and text structures, ensuring linguistic quality and consistency.

  • Deliver high-quality work within established deadlines and communicate proactively about project progress and challenges.

What We're Looking For:

  • Languages: Native Spanish speaker and Full Professional Level of English

  • Linguistic Expertise: A degree or strong background in Italian linguistics, computational linguistics, or a related field.

  • Medical Knowledge: Familiarity with Spanish medical terminology or prior experience in the healthcare domain.

  • Data Annotation: Hands-on experience with data annotation, transcription, and labeling tools.

  • Text Analysis: Proficiency in working with text patterns and dictionaries for NLP purposes.

  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional ability to assess and improve data quality.

  • Self-Management: Strong ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and consistently meet deadlines.

Which skills are 'bonus points'?

  • Previous experience in AI, machine learning, or data preparation projects.

  • Knowledge of multiple languages or dialects beyond Spanish and English.

  • Exposure to medical coding systems (e.g., ICD, CPT) or electronic health records (EHR).

  • Experience working as a freelancer on similar annotation or linguistic projects.

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

At Docplanner we are a diverse group of over 300 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.es/Overview/Working-at-DocPlanner-EI_IE1071394.11,21.htm?countryRedirect=true speak for themselves. In this role as a Product Analyst at Docplanner you'll own the metrics and analytical direction for your product area, working directly with Product Directors to influence strategy and roadmap priorities. Your insights will drive real decisions: what we build, what we kill, and where we invest next.

This means the autonomy to dig into the problems that matter, challenge conventional thinking, and push for change when the data tells a different story. You'll define what success looks like, build the frameworks to measure it, and make sure every major decision is backed by solid analysis.

You'll work with a talented team of analysts, researchers, product managers, designers, and engineers who are obsessed with building the best product. Your analyses will directly shape Product strategy and influence how millions of patients and healthcare professionals experience Docplanner.

DP Payments is a sub-unit of two fully autonomous product teams, PMs, engineers and a designer — with the mandate and capability to work across virtually any app or repository in the Docplanner ecosystem. We're building a new revenue stream for the company, which means combining the maturity of a scale-up with the agility of a startup.

The challenge

Payments has to live inside almost every app and view Docplanner has. We don't get the comfort of a greenfield or a clean separation, but we're held to the expectations of one. The challenge is to keep iterating fast inside a complex ecosystem of mature processes and products.

 - Work with higher management, business stakeholders and researchers to create and validate hypotheses from both a qualitative and quantitative perspective.

 - Create and maintain dashboards, analysis and forecasts related to our team’s main metrics.

 - Manipulate and transform large data-sets to bring new insights and perform root-cause analysis.

 - Collaborate with the Product team to test new features and validate hypotheses through experimentation and AB Testing.

 - Perform segmentation analysis to understand who our customers are and what are their main drivers to engage with our products.

 - Build, maintain and continuously evolve the analytics stack for a complex set of processes spread across many apps and technologies — centred on accepting and processing patient payments to doctors and clinics for their appointments.

Who are you?

 - You are curious by nature, and you love to ask and answer questions and dig into data.

 - You like finding patterns in data and proactively suggesting stakeholders how to improve the product.

 - You have an excellent understanding of statistics.

 - You enjoy constant learning and high autonomy.

 - You enjoy being part of a diverse analytics team.

 - You enjoy training and coaching others.

 - You are familiar with complex Product organizations in the SaaS market.

 - You enjoy using cutting-edge tools, frameworks and incorporating AI to automate and improve your work.

 - 3+ years of relevant experience in analytics, working with business KPIs and metrics, of which 2+ working closely with product managers and user research teams.

 - You are familiar with the tools that we use:
   
   - Proficiency in SQL (essential) and experienced with DBT.
   
   - Data visualization tools such as Tableau, PowerBI or similar (essential)
   
   - Event-tracking tools such as Google Analytics, Amplitude or similar (essential)
   
   - Python and its ecosystem of Data Science libraries
   
   - Experienced in working with Claude Code or similar AI IDEs.

 - Great communication skills and stakeholder management. You translate complex analyses into clear insights that executives and stakeholders actually act on.

 - Fluent in manipulating, transforming, and reshaping data, preferably from multiple data sources.

 - Doing root-cause analysis, applying statistical concepts like regressions, and proving correlations and causation.

 - Contributing to data warehouses, creating aggregated data sets, general understanding of data pipelines and flows.

 - Experience designing, implementing and measuring A/B Tests and interpreting the results.

 - Experience enabling others by training stakeholders on tools and helping teams become more data-literate and autonomous.

Let’s talk money

 - A salary adequate to your experience: ranging from €46,000 to €56,000 per year.

 - Additional paid holiday on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).

jobs.title: Regional Patient Care Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

How will you make an impact?
Job Purpose

As Patient Care Regional Manager, you will be the people manager and operational lead for Patient Care teams in your assigned European markets. You will own team performance, quality reviews, and day-to-day operations — while working closely with Country Managers and the Global Patient Care Head to align on priorities and ensure service consistency across markets.

You will be the missing link between global standards and local execution: someone who can read data, give direct feedback, run a tight operational cadence, and genuinely develop the people on your team.

Key Responsibilities

People Management

  • Own performance reviews, 1:1s, and development conversations for direct reports across your markets

  • Manage absence, availability, and team sizing for your region

  • Lead hiring decisions and internal mobility within the Patient Care team

  • Build a culture of direct feedback and consistent follow-through

Operational Performance

  • Track and own regional KPIs: response SLA, first-contact resolution, CSAT, and quality scores

  • Run quality review and moderation programs — calibration sessions, rubric definition, feedback loops

  • Identify performance trends using dashboards and reports; translate them into concrete actions

  • Own escalation protocols for complex patient cases

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Country Managers to align on priorities, workload, and service commitments

  • Work with the Product/PATS team on tooling rollouts, workflow automation, and process improvements

  • Contribute to the monthly Patient Voice reporting — classified ticket analysis, actionable issue surfacing

  • Act as regional interface for global policy rollouts and operational changes

Qualifications

What will help you thrive?

Must-haves

  • 5+ years in customer support, patient experience, or service operations — with at least 2 years managing people

  • Experience managing teams across multiple countries in Europe (not just one market)

  • Strong people instincts: direct, empathetic, consistent — someone teams trust and grow under

  • Data-driven: comfortable with dashboards, pulling operational reports, and making decisions from numbers

  • Experience running quality review or moderation programs (calibration, rubric design, scoring)

  • Fluency in English mandatory

  • Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, Notion, or similar)

Nice to have

  • Background in healthtech, marketplace, or two-sided platforms

  • Experience working with AI-assisted support tools or automation workflows

  • Familiarity with Intercom, Zendesk, or equivalent support tooling

  • SQL knowledge or comfort querying data independently

  • Experience onboarding a new org structure or consolidating teams

  • Strong plus — Spanish, Italian, Polish, or German language speaker.

What to Expect from Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with your Hiring Manager and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

3️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

4️⃣Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior stakeholder from our Global Team.

5️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

  • Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.

  • Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.

  • Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Product Lead | 100% Remote within Europe
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Docplanner and Noa

Docplanner is a global healthcare platform connecting more than 300,000 doctors with approximately 100 million patients every month across 13 markets.

Within Docplanner, Noa is on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. We build AI that works alongside doctors to:

  • Remove their administrative work.

  • Help them make better decisions and handle repeatable cases, so they can spend their time where it matters most.

  • Help patients navigate healthcare using their medical history as personalized context.

We're already in doctors' hands: Noa Notes takes documentation off their plates, while Noa Evidence brings trustworthy medical evidence to the point of care.

The next frontier is the hardest—and the most valuable: helping doctors, and eventually patients, make decisions while our AI safely takes on repeatable clinical work. That's where a doctor's judgment has to live inside the product itself. That's this role.

About the role

You'll help take Noa from writing notes and providing evidence to helping doctors decide—and make sure that doctors and users trust it.

This isn't a traditional CMO, advisory or regulatory role. It's a hands-on clinical-product role: the clinician–product–AI. You'll do two things:

  • Help decide what we build for doctors by bringing their real needs, habits and workflows into the product.

  • Define the clinical quality of what we ship: what's correct, useful and safe, and make sure we can prove it.

Because you're a doctor yourself, you can talk to our users peer-to-peer and get the honest answers a survey never will. As our first dedicated clinical hire on the product, you'll set the approach, then help grow clinical expertise across Docplanner's AI product teams.

You'll work day-to-day with Product, AI, Design, Engineering, Regulatory and our doctor network.

What you'll do

Shape what we build

  • Bring how doctors really work (habits, preferences, workflow, admin) into the product.

  • Talk to doctors, doctor-to-doctor, and turn candid feedback into product decisions.

  • Partner with Product on the roadmap: what to build and what will actually get used.

Make sure it's clinically sound

  • Define the clinical quality bar and intended outcomes for our AI products.

  • Review and improve prompts, model outputs, clinical templates, workflows and terminology.

  • Spot clinical failure modes: what good and unacceptable outputs look like.

  • Direct clinical evaluation: decide what to test, in what mix (specialty, population, complexity and edge cases), and set the bar. You'll bootstrap this with a dedicated owner who runs the process, tooling and annotation guidelines for doctors, while our clinical network performs the annotation.

  • Turn model errors and clinician feedback into concrete product and model improvements.

Keep it safe and scalable

  • Work with ML/LLM teams, Regulatory experts and the PRRC to keep intent, evidence, risks and controls aligned, including EU MDR-related and similar requirements.

  • Build feedback loops with practising clinicians and our consultant-doctor network.

  • Define how clinical-product expertise scales across future products, teams and markets.

What we're looking for

  • A medical degree and meaningful experience practising medicine, with a strong understanding of clinicians' day-to-day work. Active licensure and current clinical practice are not required, although recent or ongoing practice is valuable.

  • You've helped build and ship a digital health, clinical software or AI product—either within a product team or through meaningful entrepreneurial experience.

  • You've turned clinical problems into product decisions, not just provided advice or review.

  • Strong clinical judgment: you turn quality and safety into standards technical teams can use.

  • You win doctors' trust quickly—you are the peer who gets the honest answer.

  • You communicate clearly and directly across clinical, product, technical, regulatory and leadership teams.

  • You're comfortable working at a senior, hands-on level in a fast-moving, international team.

  • You actively use generative AI and understand its potential and limitations. Hands-on experience with prompting, evaluation, error analysis, human oversight or AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code is a plus.

Bonus: experience with ambient documentation, clinical templates, medical-knowledge systems, clinical coding, evaluation datasets or building and certifying regulated Software as a Medical Device (SaMD).

What success looks like after six months

  • A clear clinical quality framework for our priority AI products.

  • Clinically grounded evaluation sets and thresholds in place.

  • A repeatable way to turn medical expertise into better product and model decisions.

Why join Noa at Docplanner

  • Real impact at real scale: Your work reaches hundreds of thousands of doctors and their patients.

  • Shape what comes next: You'll influence what Noa and Docplanner's AI products become—and whether doctors and patients trust them.

  • Ship to learn: A feature in front of users beats another month of planning.

  • Work flexibly: The role is 100% remote within Poland or Spain, with the team coming together regularly.
